units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:3">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite> (expl. <he>נרדי</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:3">ib.</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01265"><he>נֵרְדְּ</he></cite>) <he>סִירְיִי נתן ריחו</he> my offense (the making of the golden calf) gave forth its odor.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 391:14">Yalk. Ex. 391</cite> (ref. to Cant. l. c.) <he>היה לו לומר נרדי נתן סִירְיוֹ</he> (not <he>שנ׳</he>) it ought to have read, ‘my nard gave forth its stench’.
